site.name: PulseOdds
site.tagline: Read the odds. Own the edge. Beat the Bookies.
site.description: PulseOdds is a mathematical sports odds screening platform for football, basketball, tennis and table tennis. It provides instant profile verdicts, confidence scoring, and auto-saved picks for informed punters.

capabilities: Sports odds screening (football, basketball, tennis, table tennis)
Decimal odds profile analysis with 4-model verdict engine
Top Pick ranking with gold/silver/bronze badges
BTTS and correct score clustering — football
Auto-save screener state via Convex cloud
